verdict.rationale: Gram's Connect page explicitly lets developers 'discover and import official third-party MCP servers, powered by the official MCP Registry' and lists all tool sources (OpenAPI, functions, third-party catalog servers, custom/tunneled MCP servers) in one place, which supports catalog browsing before wiring into an agent. However, evidence doesn't detail search-by-capability filtering, catalog size, or independent hands-on confirmation of the browsing UX. Missing for 10: detail on capability-based search/filtering mechanics, evidence of catalog scale, and independent/hands-on validation of the discovery experience.
